item.summary: fix(system-agent): leave reasoning room in local model setup probes (#124405) * fix(system-agent): increase setup inference probe max tokens from 32 to 128 The 32-token cap starves reasoning models that spend tokens on thinking before emitting visible text. The probe gets a reasoning-only turn and reports healthy local models as broken inference. Increase to 128 tokens to accommodate reasoning model thinking overhead. Fixes #124345 * fix(system-agent): leave reasoning room in setup probes Co-authored-by: synthclaw --------- Co-authored-by: Peter Steinberger
